plugin.description: Send messages to your ChatGPT Dot, to ChatGPT chats (a new one or a recent conversation), to Codex sessions running on your computers, and to Codex Cloud tasks. With no chat named, sends to your Dot (the default when the account has one), a new ChatGPT chat or the chat chosen in settings. Supports chat nicknames. Say "start a new task" to start a new Codex session in a project folder on one of your computers, or a new Codex Cloud task, as chosen in settings. Sign in in settings.

actions.name: send_to_agent
actions.description: Send a message to the user's ChatGPT Dot, to a ChatGPT chat (a new one, or a recent chatgpt.com conversation), or to one of their Codex chats: a Codex session running on their computer, or a Codex Cloud task. chat_id is an instanceId from agent/chats ("new-chat" starts a new ChatGPT chat), or a chat nickname or part of its title; "new task" starts a new Codex session on the computer and project folder chosen in settings (or a new Codex Cloud task, if settings choose that), with the message as its first prompt; omit it to send where settings choose (the Dot, a new ChatGPT chat or a default chat). Never use it for notes, reminders, or messages meant for anyone else. Returns a receipt, not the reply; a ChatGPT chat's receipt may quote the start of the reply. Do not automatically retry an uncertain delivery.

message.description: What to tell the Dot, ChatGPT or Codex, without the "tell my Dot", "ask ChatGPT" or "tell Codex" instruction itself.

chat_id.description: The chat's instanceId from agent/chats ("new-chat" for a new ChatGPT chat), or a chat's nickname or part of its title. Use "new task" when the user asks to start a new task or Codex session. Omit to send where settings choose.

actions.name: start_codex_cloud_task
actions.description: Start a new Codex Cloud task (chatgpt.com/codex), which works in a cloud copy of one of the user's GitHub repositories. Use when the user asks for coding work in Codex Cloud or on a named repo rather than in a session on their computer; for a plain "start a new task", use send_to_agent with chat_id "new task", which follows settings. Returns a receipt; the task takes minutes to run.

prompt.description: The task for Codex, without the "ask Codex Cloud" instruction itself.

environment.description: The Codex Cloud environment's name (usually the repository). Omit for the user's pinned or first environment.
